# TMG Maximo development

Read `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before working, then read
`skills/maximo-dev/SKILL.md` and the task-specific skill listed there.
Use `python3 -m maxdev` when MCP is unavailable. All live writes require a dry run
and explicit user approval; never edit environment secrets or bypass protection.
The shared guide and `docs/standards/TMG_AUTOSCRIPT_STANDARDS.md` are authoritative.
